text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: After a race, I actually catch sight of Doto! In the flesh! She's been slow to improve recently, so I get a glimpse of her looking down…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I recognize the issue as her not having entered her "race-ready" state yet, but apparently she herself isn't aware…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My trainer pushes me to share my knowledge, but I know I won't ever stop yapping if I get started!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: My worst fears come true as I end up imposing on my oshi and rambling on at Mach two speed! There's no way this conversation is going to be useful to her!
